game_concept: A card battler set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clues value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about clues to power up the camel trader and open the oasis.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Palm Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clues changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
